tools.name: dex_list_remote_capture_eligible_devices
tools.description: Retrieve a list of devices eligible for remote captures. You'll need the device_id and user_email from this response in order to create a remote capture for a specific device. It can also be used as a generic source to find devices registered to the account, filtering by user email if necessary.

page.description: The page of results to retrieve.

search.description: Filter devices by name or email.

tools.name: dex_create_remote_pcap
tools.description: Create a remote packet capture (PCAP) for a device. This is a resource intensive and privacy-sensitive operation on a real user device.Always ask for confirmation from the user that the targeted email and device are correct before executing a capture

user_email.description: The email of the user associated with the device.

max-file-size-mb.description: Maximum file size in MB for the capture file. Specifies the maximum file size of the warp-daig zip artifact that can be uploaded. If the zip artifact exceeds the specified max file size it will NOT be uploaded.

packet-size-bytes.description: Maximum number of bytes to save for each packet.

time-limit-min.description: Limit on capture duration in minutes

tools.name: dex_create_remote_warp_diag
tools.description: Create a remote Warp Diagnostic (WARP-diag) for a device. This is a resource intensive and privacy-sensitive operation on a real user device.Always ask for confirmation from the user that the targeted email and device are correct before executing a capture

user_email.description: The email of the user associated with the device.

test-all-routes.description: Test an IP address from all included or excluded ranges. Tests an IP address from all included or excluded ranges.Essentially the same as running 'route get '' and collecting the results. This option may increase the time taken to collect the warp-diag

tools.name: dex_list_remote_captures
tools.description: Retrieve a list of remote captures for device debugging, like PCAPs or WARP Diags.

page.description: The page of results to retrieve.

tools.name: dex_fleet_status_live
tools.description: Retrieve details about the real-time status of the fleet of devices broken down by dimension (mode, status, colo, platform, version)

since_minutes.description: Number of minutes before current time to use as cutoff for device states to include.

colo.description: Optionally filter results to a specific Cloudflare colo.

tools.name: dex_fleet_status_over_time

from.description: The datetime of the beginning point of time range for results. Must be in ISO 8601 datetime string in the extended format with UTC time (e.g, 2025-04-21T18:00:00Z).

to.description: The datetime of the ending point of time range for results. Must be in ISO 8601 datetime string in the extended format with UTC time (e.g, 2025-04-22T00:00:00Z).

interval.description: The time interval to group results by.

colo.description: Filter results to WARP devices connected to a specific colo.

device_id.description: Filter results to a specific device.

tools.name: dex_fleet_status_logs
tools.description: Retrieve raw fleet status device logs with a variety of levels of granularity and filtering. Use `source=last_seen` to view logs showing the last known state per device within the specified time period. Use `source=hourly` to view logs showing an hourly rollup per device where values are the average value of allevents within the time period. Use `source=raw` to view all logs for the specified period.

page.description: The page of results to retrieve.

from.description: The datetime of the beginning point of time range for results. Must be in ISO 8601 datetime string in the extended format with UTC time (e.g, 2025-04-21T18:00:00Z).

to.description: The datetime of the ending point of time range for results. Must be in ISO 8601 datetime string in the extended format with UTC time (e.g, 2025-04-22T00:00:00Z).

colo.description: Optionally filter results to a specific Cloudflare colo.

device_id.description: Filter results to a specific device.

mode.description: Filter results to devices with a specific WARP mode.

platform.description: Filter results to devices on a specific operating system.

status.description: Filter results to devices with a specific WARP connection status.

version.description: Filter results to devices with a specific WARP client version.

tools.name: dex_list_warp_change_events
tools.description: View logs of events when users toggle WARP on or off, or change configurations.

from.description: The datetime of the beginning point of time range for results. Must be in ISO 8601 datetime string in the extended format with UTC time (e.g, 2025-04-21T18:00:00Z).

to.description: The datetime of the ending point of time range for results. Must be in ISO 8601 datetime string in the extended format with UTC time (e.g, 2025-04-22T00:00:00Z).

page.description: The page of results to retrieve.

account_name.description: Optionally filter events by account name.

config_name.description: Optionally filter events by WARP configuration name changed from or to. Applicable to `type=config` events only.

toggle.description: Optionally filter events by toggle value. Applicable to `type=toggle` events only.

tools.name: dex_list_colos
tools.description: View a list of Cloudflare colos sorted alphabetically or by frequency encountered in fleet status or DEX test data.

from.description: The datetime of the beginning point of time range for results. Must be in ISO 8601 datetime string in the extended format with UTC time (e.g, 2025-04-21T18:00:00Z).

to.description: The datetime of the ending point of time range for results. Must be in ISO 8601 datetime string in the extended format with UTC time (e.g, 2025-04-22T00:00:00Z).

sortBy.description: Use `fleet-status-usage` to sort by frequency seen in device state checkins.Use `application-tests-usage` to sort by frequency seen in DEX test results. Omit to sort alphabetically.
